newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro earns est up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Radio Centro earns est up.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns & Co. said on Thursday it raised its 1996 earnings estimates for Mexican broadcaster Grupo Radio Centro to $0.27 per American Depositary Share from $0.20.
-- The brokerage increased its estimated earnings of the company a month ago to $0.20 from $0.14, wrote analysts Carlos Laboy and Hector Tassinari in a report.
-- "While our December estimate increase was driven by lower cost assumptions and lower taxes, it appears that Christmas produced solid broadcast activity," the analysts said.
-- The brokerage said it expects the broadcaster to see a 39 percent increase in net earnings, citing "fixed and efficient cost structure."
-- "We continue to rate Grupo Radio Centro attractive given that it is premature to forecast with conviction the ramp up in broadcast activities looking into 1997," the report said.
-- Radio Centro's New York ADS were unchanged at midday at 7-1/2.
